Integrated metabolic pathways and their modulation versus disruption in disease contexts

Integrated metabolic pathways and their modulation versus disruption in disease contexts. Abbreviations: IDO, indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase; KYN, kynurenine; 3-HAA, 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid; QA, quinolinic acid; NAD⁺, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide; NOS, nitric oxide synthase; CVD, cardiac vascular dysfunction; ARG1, arginase-1; NO, nitric oxide; CIT, citrulline; ASP, aspartate; ASS, argininosuccinate synthase; ASA, argininosuccinate; Orn, ornithine; ACS, acyl-CoA synthetase; LCAC, long-chain acyl-carnitine; CPT1, carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1; FAO, fatty acid oxidation; ACLY, ATP-citrate lyase; ACC1, acetyl-CoA carboxylase 1; PDH, pyruvate dehydrogenase; LDH, lactate dehydrogenase; TCA, tricarboxylic acid; α-KG, α-ketoglutarate; ECM, extracellular matrix; ROS, reactive oxygen species; TGF-β, transforming growth factor-β; HIF-1α, hypoxia-inducible factor-1α. Icons: Green checkmark = normal physiological modulation/homeostasis; Red X = disrupted modulation/homeostasis of the pathway; ↑= increase; ↓= decrease. Figure created using BioRender.com
